name: session-crew
description: A panel of the side sessions this Claude Code desktop session started (/crew): name, title, status and time, each a savvy-progress crab in a costume that walks while it works, rests while idle and celebrates when done.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: pattern=costume pairs, matched against a session's name, title or id (* and ? globs, first match wins), e.g. nut-*=engineer. Costumes: astronaut, detective, engineer, chef, racer, pirate, plain. Unmatched sessions take the next costume in turn.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask the desktop app for linked sessions while any is working; 0 turns polling off.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: pattern=label pairs for the strip, matched against a session's name, title or id (* and ? globs, first match wins), e.g. todo-*=To-do mod. Up to 16 characters show.

aiLabels.title: Short labels from titles
aiLabels.description: Asks a small model (Haiku, low effort) once per session for a 1-3 word label from its title; off, the title is shortened by rule.

stripScale.title: Strip crab size
stripScale.description: How large the strip's crabs draw, 0.8 to 2.5.

strip.title: Crab strip above the prompt
strip.description: Shows a small crab for each working, waiting or just-finished session above the prompt. /crew strip on|off overrides it.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a session starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the crew panel whenever start_session proposes or starts a session.
